source: Blitz quiz from Thomas Erikson, «Surrounded by Idiots» (English original), chapter 20 «A Quick Little Quiz to See What You've Learned» + answers «The Answers to the Questions in Chapter 20». Verbatim snapshot from epub (~/Рабочий стол/Surrounded_by_Idiots.epub), cross-checked against Surrounded-By-Idiots-Thomas-Erikson-1.pdf — 23 questions. The Russian edition has 24 (an extra criticism question at #12) — see quiz-with-key.md.
note_matching: aliases — accepted paraphrases (normalized: lower, punctuation→space). Single-color questions are matched by color stems and letters D/I/S/C (see runner.py).

kind_meaning.color: key — one profile; matched via color tokens
kind_meaning.book: key — a compatibility/team rule of the course's methodology (per Erikson's materials); common DISC versions teach it differently (complementary pairs), so models without the course material consistently answer differently
